name: oh-my-pi
description: Coding agent CLI with subagents and LSP, built by Stencil Labs (binary omp). Installed from the prebuilt release, which the installer checks against its sha256.
install: mkdir -p {{prefix}}/bin; t=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL https://omp.sh/install -o "$t" && PI_INSTALL_DIR={{prefix}}/bin sh "$t" --binary; rc=$?; rm -f "$t"; exit $rc
upgrade: mkdir -p {{prefix}}/bin; t=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL https://omp.sh/install -o "$t" && PI_INSTALL_DIR={{prefix}}/bin sh "$t" --binary; rc=$?; rm -f "$t"; exit $rc
